allowed_evidence: pinned source metadata and bounded paraphrases
production parser, semantic, instantiation, admission, compiler, contract, and profile results
exact artifact digests and typed pointers
disallowed_evidence: the existing scenario stress corpus as the representative request corpus
post-hoc removal or repair of falsifying concepts
claim.objective_fail_criteria: A load-bearing concept is missing or lossy, an applicable stage fails, or backend vocabulary is required in core SDL while the result claims success.
claim.objective_pass_criteria: Every load-bearing concept passes at every owning stage, backend-specific mechanics stay outside core SDL, and no requested concept is silently lost.
claim.statement: RAES provides a standardized configurable portable specification surface for the preregistered representative cyber-agent evaluation environment requirements without backend vocabulary in core SDL.
threats_to_validity: The representative corpus contains four source strata and sixteen atomic concepts rather than every cyber-range requirement.
The reference processor and repository fixtures are not independent backend implementations.
No live range, simulator federation, or participant execution was part of this offline specification-coverage test.

limitations: This result demonstrates bounded specification coverage, not universal cyber-range coverage, usability, adoption, backend substitution, or behavioral equivalence.
The three missing concepts are evidence, not implementation tasks within this snapshot.
The retained protocol does not test recursive realization or plan-level profile semantics; this release only re-establishes its original bounded coverage result against the current implementation.
plain_language_outcome: The retained corpus replays against open-by-default augmentation scope without changing its preregistered classifications or claim limits. Native backend scope enforcement is not evaluated by this corpus.
